$comment: The closed lists of front matter fields, per kind of file and per target. Claude Code ignores a misspelled field without a word, so the check reads these. The portable six are the open Agent Skills specification; the rest are Claude Code's own (dashes in a skill, camelCase in a subagent). A target is added here, with a test, when its list has been read at the source. The Gemini CLI list is read at geminicli.com/docs/core/subagents (2026-11-23); the Codex one at learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents, which does not claim its list is complete. agents/openai.yaml is read at learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills (2026-11-23): interface, policy and dependencies; dependencies.tools is a list of maps, outside the subset this check reads, so a file that uses it is reported as nested.
